title: Headless fix build for Brett's AmberX app (apps/amberx-droid in AmberX-AXF).
asked: Headless fix build for Brett's AmberX app (apps/amberx-droid in AmberX-AXF). Load rules from axHub (mcp__axHub__call axhub.memory_read, project amberx-axf, area claude). Opus, one session. Brett is live on his phone and blocked. Two bugs: 1. VOICE LOOP: AmberX keeps SPEAKING "no saved inbox" / "no saved note(s)" over and over. Find what speaks empty-state text (hands-free listening, agent voice, notes/inbox, overlay, command center, polling/refresh that re-announces). Fix: empty states are never spoken; any spoken status is said at most once per real change (dedupe + debounce), never on a poll/refresh/re-render; no loop between TTS output and the mic (holdMic / mic lease). Add a test that a repeated empty refresh speaks nothing. 2. SCREEN RECORD BLOCKED: Android says it can't record/screenshot "due to security policy" = FLAG_SECURE (or equivalent) on AmberX's window. Fix: no FLAG_SECURE on normal screens. Only an opt-in setting "Hide sensitive screens from recordings" (OFF by default), applied only while a password/key/vault screen is showing. Make sure AmberX's own screen recorder (Audio Extract) and Android's recorder both work. Then: run the repo checks + AmberX tests, commit, push branch, open a PR, then merge origin/main, retest and push to main (Brett said push to main tonight). CI builds the new APK. Report in detailed style (file touched, what was wrong, before/after) to _claude/builds/reports/amberx-fix-loop-securescreen.md.

result.summary: Voice loop + FLAG_SECURE fixed and tested (test.mjs 1996→2037 pass); committed locally, push blocked: VPS GitHub token invalid
